title: Constructibility and Tor bounds under embedded finite-field realization
statement: For a Noetherian scheme X, a finite field A of Type 0 with discrete topological-ring structure and any derived complex B of internal modules over the pulled-back constant ring discreteObj A, the conjunction of constant-model constructibility of all homology objects and finite relative Tor amplitude is equivalent to intrinsically constructible homology with a single ordered finite interval of vanishing for finiteRealization X A from [def-sfb-embedded-finite-coefficient-realization]. This is a statement about arbitrary finite-field complexes, not integral reduction or etale origin.

source.place: First paragraph, clauses (1) and (2); Stacks Tags 099L, 03ET, 00YV, 06YQ and 09AL.

proof.text: Use the common exact coefficient-module presentation E,H and its natural comparison with the specified finiteRealization. The exact-functor homology isomorphisms identify E(H^i B) with H(H^i finiteRealization(B)); faithfulness of H reflects zero objects, and the heart constructibility comparison identifies the two constructibility predicates degree by degree.

Apply the adopted source theorem torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_obj_iff to the strong monoidal equivalence E. On the small coefficient site, nativeTor_iff from the coefficient flat-model proof identifies this with the recorded K-flat tensor test. Replace an unordered witness [a,b] by [min(a,b),b].

Apply constant_field_finite_tor_amplitude_iff to the lifted field ULift A and E(B). Transport each homology vanishing condition through the exact-functor homology isomorphism and the faithful equivalence H. Combine this boundedness equivalence with the degreewise constructibility equivalences by conjunction.

theorem finiteFieldCohomologyCriterion
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (A : Type) [Field A]
    [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A] [Finite A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    (B : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (discreteObj A) X))) :
    letI : HasSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      CategoryTheory.siteAbelianHasSheafify.{u + 1, u, u + 1} _
    letI : (Scheme.ProEt.topology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} :=
      CategoryTheory.siteAbelianWEqualsLocallyBijective.{u + 1, u, u + 1} _
    ((∀ i : ℤ, IsConstantModelConstructible (discreteObj A) X
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor.{u + 1} _ i).obj B)) ∧
      DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ B) ↔
    ((∀ i : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf X (ULift.{u, 0} A)
        ((@DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules X (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing X (ULift.{u, 0} A)))
          _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) i).obj ((finiteRealization X A).obj B))) ∧
      ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
        IsZero ((@DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (Scheme.proEtaleRingModules X (Scheme.proEtaleConstantRing X (ULift.{u, 0} A)))
          _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) i).obj ((finiteRealization X A).obj B)))
